//go:build integration

package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	courseclient "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/courseclient"
	privatehttp "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root alone prepares and launches this bounded disposable provider. All
// business write ports are actual owner use cases and PostgreSQL. The two
// learner profiles and explicitly named mastery projection are synthetic;
// they do not claim production evidence ingestion or mastery reduction.
func TestT19ServePlanningStudentHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("T19_SERVE_STUDENT") != "true" {
		t.Skip("owned T19 Student provider gate absent")
	}
	ready, stop, result := os.Getenv("T19_STUDENT_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T19_STUDENT_STOP_FILE"), os.Getenv("T19_STUDENT_RESULT_FILE")
	token := os.Getenv("T19_STUDENT_TOKEN")
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("T19_STUDENT_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t19_student_integration_proof" || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58998 || token == "" || ready == "" || stop == "" || result == "" || ready == stop || ready == result || stop == result {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact owned Student configuration required")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{ready, stop, result} {
		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: metadata and stop paths must be absent")
		}
	}
	var course struct {
		URL      string `json:"url"`
		Database string `json:"database"`
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv("T19_COURSE_READY_FILE"))
	if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(raw, &course) != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: owned Course metadata unavailable")
	}
	courseURL, err := url.Parse(course.URL)
	if err != nil || courseURL.Scheme != "http" || courseURL.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || courseURL.Port() == "" || courseURL.User != nil || courseURL.Path != "" || courseURL.RawQuery != "" || courseURL.Fragment != "" || course.Database != "remediation_t19_course_test" || os.Getenv("T19_COURSE_TOKEN") == "" || os.Getenv("T19_COURSE_TOKEN") == token {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: dedicated loopback Course and distinct provider tokens required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: Student pool unavailable")
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	var database string
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database()`).Scan(&database) != nil || database != cfg.ConnConfig.Database {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact Student database unavailable")
	}
	clock, ids := t19StudentClock{}, t19StudentIDs{}
	profiles := &StudentOnboardingRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	mastery := &LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	journey := &LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	assignments := &CourseAssignmentRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	putProfile := studentuc.PutStudentOnboarding{Profiles: profiles, Clock: clock}
	owner, existingOwner := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	owned := func(id string) bool { return id == owner || id == existingOwner }
	for _, id := range []string{owner, existingOwner} {
		profile, err := putProfile.Handle(ctx, studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingInput{StudentID: id, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner", KnownStacks: []string{}, DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "learn_programming", PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 120, PreferredPace: "steady"})
		if err != nil || profile.Version != 1 {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: actual onboarding fixture failed")
		}
	}
	httpClient := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second, Transport: &http.Transport{Proxy: nil}}
	revisions := courseclient.Client{BaseURL: course.URL, InternalToken: os.Getenv("T19_COURSE_TOKEN"), HTTPClient: httpClient}
	assign := studentuc.AssignCourse{Assignments: assignments, Clock: clock, IDs: ids}
	replace := studentuc.ReplaceLearningPath{Revisions: revisions, Journey: journey, Clock: clock, IDs: ids}
	planning := studentuc.LearningPathPlanning{Revisions: revisions, Paths: journey, Clock: clock}
	registered := chi.NewRouter()
	registered.Mount("/internal", privatehttp.NewRouter(&privatehandlers.Handler{
		LearnerOverview: studentuc.GetLearnerOverview{Profiles: profiles, Mastery: mastery, Journey: journey},
		Mastery:         studentuc.GetTargetMastery{Mastery: mastery}, CourseAssignments: assign, LearningPaths: replace,
		LearningPathPlanning: planning, LearningPathCompletion: studentuc.CompleteLearningPath{Journey: journey, Clock: clock},
		OnboardingProfiles: studentuc.GetStudentOnboarding{Profiles: profiles}, PlanningReadiness: studentuc.GetStudentPlanningReadiness{Reader: profiles},
	}, token, token))
	var mu sync.Mutex
	assignmentCut, pathCut := false, false
	assignmentCutCount, pathCutCount, profileReads, masteryReads, planningReads := 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	assignmentKeys, pathKeys := []string{}, []string{}
	state := func(readCtx context.Context, id string) (map[string]any, error) {
		profile, err := profiles.Get(readCtx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		projection, err := mastery.ListRecentStudentTargetMastery(readCtx, id, 20)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		paths, err := journey.ListLearningPaths(readCtx, id, 100)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		courses, err := assignments.List(readCtx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		value := map[string]any{"student_id": id, "database": database, "profile": profile, "mastery": projection, "paths": paths, "assignments": courses,
			"classification": "actual registered Student learner overview/mastery/assignment/path HTTP and owner usecases/PG; synthetic profiles and explicitly named mastery projection; no LLM, JWT or live E2E"}
		counts := map[string]int64{}
		for _, table := range []string{"student_course_assignment", "student_learning_path", "student_learning_path_item", "student_learning_path_revision", "student_learning_path_request", "student_learning_path_command", "student_target_mastery", "student_learning_action", "student_learning_evidence", "student_lesson_activity_fact"} {
			query := `SELECT count(*) FROM ` + table + ` WHERE student_id=$1`
			if table == "student_learning_path_item" || table == "student_learning_path_revision" {
				query = `SELECT count(*) FROM ` + table + ` WHERE student_learning_path_id IN (SELECT id FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1)`
			}
			var n int64
			if err := pool.QueryRow(readCtx, query, id).Scan(&n); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			counts[table] = n
		}
		value["counts"] = counts
		for key, query := range map[string]string{
			"assignment_requests": `SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.idempotency_key),'[]'::jsonb) FROM student_course_assignment_request r JOIN student_course_assignment a ON a.id=r.assignment_id WHERE a.student_id=$1`,
			"path_commands":       `SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.idempotency_key),'[]'::jsonb) FROM student_learning_path_command r WHERE r.student_id=$1`,
			"path_revisions":      `SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.created_at,r.version),'[]'::jsonb) FROM student_learning_path_revision r JOIN student_learning_path p ON p.id=r.student_learning_path_id WHERE p.student_id=$1`,
		} {
			var raw json.RawMessage
			if err := pool.QueryRow(readCtx, query, id).Scan(&raw); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			value[key] = raw
		}
		mu.Lock()
		value["assignment_cut_enabled"], value["path_cut_enabled"] = assignmentCut, pathCut
		value["assignment_cut_count"], value["path_cut_count"] = assignmentCutCount, pathCutCount
		value["profile_reads"], value["mastery_reads"], value["planning_state_reads"] = profileReads, masteryReads, planningReads
		value["assignment_http_keys"], value["path_http_keys"] = append([]string{}, assignmentKeys...), append([]string{}, pathKeys...)
		mu.Unlock()
		return value, nil
	}
	protected := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != token {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	decode := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, value any) bool {
		d := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 128*1024))
		d.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if d.Decode(value) != nil || d.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
			w.WriteHeader(400)
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	encode := func(w http.ResponseWriter, value any, err error) {
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "owned control failed", 500)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /__t19/state", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !protected(w, r) {
			return
		}
		id := r.URL.Query().Get("student_id")
		if id == "" {
			id = owner
		}
		if !owned(id) {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		readCtx, finish := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Second)
		defer finish()
		value, err := state(readCtx, id)
		encode(w, value, err)
	})
	for _, kind := range []string{"assignment", "path"} {
		kind := kind
		mux.HandleFunc("POST /__t19/"+kind+"-cut", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if !protected(w, r) {
				return
			}
			var input struct {
				Enabled *bool `json:"enabled"`
			}
			if !decode(w, r, &input) {
				return
			}
			if input.Enabled == nil {
				w.WriteHeader(400)
				return
			}
			mu.Lock()
			if kind == "assignment" {
				assignmentCut = *input.Enabled
			} else {
				pathCut = *input.Enabled
			}
			mu.Unlock()
			w.WriteHeader(204)
		})
	}
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /__t19/profile", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !protected(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var input struct {
			StudentID     string   `json:"student_id"`
			KnownStacks   []string `json:"known_stacks"`
			DesiredStacks []string `json:"desired_stacks"`
			GoalCode      string   `json:"goal_code"`
			DirectionCode string   `json:"direction_code"`
		}
		if !decode(w, r, &input) {
			return
		}
		if !owned(input.StudentID) {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		current, err := profiles.Get(r.Context(), input.StudentID)
		if err != nil {
			encode(w, nil, err)
			return
		}
		if input.GoalCode == "" {
			input.GoalCode = current.GoalCode
		}
		if input.DirectionCode == "" {
			input.DirectionCode = current.DirectionCode
		}
		profile, err := putProfile.Handle(r.Context(), studentuc.PutStudentOnboardingInput{StudentID: input.StudentID, ExpectedVersion: current.Version, DirectionCode: input.DirectionCode, SelfAssessedExperience: current.SelfAssessedExperience, KnownStacks: input.KnownStacks, DesiredStacks: input.DesiredStacks, GoalCode: input.GoalCode, GoalText: current.GoalText, PreferredLanguage: current.PreferredLanguage, WeeklyMinutes: current.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: current.PreferredPace})
		encode(w, profile, err)
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /__t19/mastery", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !protected(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var input struct {
			StudentID     string                     `json:"student_id"`
			Fixture       string                     `json:"fixture"`
			PolicyVersion string                     `json:"policy_version"`
			Targets       []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"targets"`
		}
		if !decode(w, r, &input) {
			return
		}
		if !owned(input.StudentID) {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		targets, err := domain.NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(input.Targets)
		if err != nil || len(targets) == 0 || len(targets) > 20 || input.Fixture != "t19-owned-mastered-projection-v1" || input.PolicyVersion != domain.MasteryPolicyVersion {
			w.WriteHeader(400)
			return
		}
		// An explicit test projection fixture, never an evidence/reducer substitute.
		tx, err := pool.Begin(r.Context())
		if err != nil {
			encode(w, nil, err)
			return
		}
		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(r.Context()) }()
		for _, target := range targets {
			_, err = tx.Exec(r.Context(), `INSERT INTO student_target_mastery (student_id,target_type,target_key,target_version,state,mastery_score,confidence,independent_success_count,assisted_success_count,failure_count,evidence_count,last_seen_at,last_practiced_at,policy_version) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'MASTERED',1,0.9,3,0,0,3,$5,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT (student_id,target_type,target_key,target_version) DO UPDATE SET state=EXCLUDED.state,mastery_score=EXCLUDED.mastery_score,confidence=EXCLUDED.confidence,independent_success_count=EXCLUDED.independent_success_count,assisted_success_count=0,failure_count=0,evidence_count=3,last_seen_at=EXCLUDED.last_seen_at,last_practiced_at=EXCLUDED.last_practiced_at,last_failed_at=NULL,policy_version=EXCLUDED.policy_version,updated_at=EXCLUDED.last_seen_at`, input.StudentID, target.Type, target.Key, target.Version, clock.Now(), domain.MasteryPolicyVersion)
			if err != nil {
				encode(w, nil, err)
				return
			}
		}
		if err = tx.Commit(r.Context()); err != nil {
			encode(w, nil, err)
			return
		}
		w.WriteHeader(204)
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /__t19/existing-path", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !protected(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var input struct {
			StudentID         string                    `json:"student_id"`
			CourseID          string                    `json:"course_id"`
			CourseFingerprint string                    `json:"course_fingerprint"`
			Items             []domain.LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
		}
		if !decode(w, r, &input) {
			return
		}
		if input.StudentID != existingOwner {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		current, err := profiles.Get(r.Context(), input.StudentID)
		if err != nil {
			encode(w, nil, err)
			return
		}
		requestID := uuid.NewString()
		_, _, err = assign.Handle(r.Context(), studentuc.AssignCourseInput{StudentID: input.StudentID, CourseID: input.CourseID, PlanningRequestID: requestID, IdempotencyKey: requestID, AssignedBy: domain.CourseAssignmentSourceLearningPlanner})
		if err != nil {
			encode(w, nil, err)
			return
		}
		path, err := replace.Handle(r.Context(), studentuc.ReplaceLearningPathInput{StudentID: input.StudentID, PlanningRequestID: requestID, IdempotencyKey: requestID, CourseID: input.CourseID, GoalCode: current.GoalCode, CurriculumRevision: input.CourseFingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "t19_fixture", ReasonSummary: "T19 actual owner path fixture", Items: input.Items})
		encode(w, path, err)
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /__t19/advance-path", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !protected(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var input struct {
			StudentID string `json:"student_id"`
			PathID    string `json:"path_id"`
		}
		if !decode(w, r, &input) {
			return
		}
		if input.StudentID != existingOwner {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		current, err := planning.Get(r.Context(), input.StudentID, input.PathID)
		if err != nil {
			encode(w, nil, err)
			return
		}
		requestID := uuid.NewString()
		advanced, err := planning.Replan(r.Context(), studentuc.LearningPathReplanInput{Schema: domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, StudentID: input.StudentID, LearningPathID: input.PathID, PlanningRequestID: requestID, IdempotencyKey: requestID, CourseID: current.CourseID, GoalCode: current.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: current.CourseFingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: current.PlannerPolicyVersion, ReasonCode: current.ReasonCode, ReasonSummary: "T19 actual owner path advance " + requestID, ExpectedPathVersion: current.PathVersion, DesiredItems: current.Items})
		if err == nil && advanced.State.PathVersion != current.PathVersion+1 {
			http.Error(w, "owned advance did not increment version", 500)
			return
		}
		encode(w, advanced, err)
	})
	mux.Handle("/", http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		parts := strings.Split(strings.Trim(r.URL.Path, "/"), "/")
		// The fault never substitutes a business port or response. It prevents
		// the registered handler from running, strictly before its owner write.
		if len(parts) >= 4 && parts[0] == "internal" && parts[1] == "students" && owned(parts[2]) && r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") == token {
			mu.Lock()
			cut := false
			switch {
			case r.Method == "GET" && len(parts) == 4 && parts[3] == "learner-overview":
				profileReads++
			case r.Method == "POST" && len(parts) == 5 && parts[3] == "mastery" && parts[4] == "query":
				masteryReads++
			case r.Method == "GET" && len(parts) == 6 && parts[3] == "learning-paths" && parts[5] == "planning-state":
				planningReads++
			case r.Method == "PUT" && len(parts) == 6 && parts[3] == "courses" && parts[5] == "assignment":
				if key := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"); t19StudentUUID(key) {
					assignmentKeys = append(assignmentKeys, key)
				}
				if assignmentCut {
					assignmentCutCount++
					cut = true
				}
			case r.Method == "PUT" && len(parts) == 5 && parts[3] == "learning-paths":
				if key := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"); t19StudentUUID(key) {
					pathKeys = append(pathKeys, key)
				}
				if pathCut {
					pathCutCount++
					cut = true
				}
			}
			mu.Unlock()
			if cut {
				http.Error(w, "T19 owned pre-handler outage", 503)
				return
			}
		}
		registered.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	}))
	server := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(mux)
	server.Config.ReadHeaderTimeout, server.Config.ReadTimeout, server.Config.WriteTimeout, server.Config.IdleTimeout = 5*time.Second, 40*time.Second, 40*time.Second, 5*time.Second
	server.Start()
	defer server.Close()
	defer server.CloseClientConnections()
	metadata, err := state(ctx, owner)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: initial Student state unavailable")
	}
	metadata["url"], metadata["existing_student_id"] = server.URL, existingOwner
	metadata["goal_code"], metadata["direction_code"], metadata["desired_stacks"], metadata["preferred_language"] = "learn_programming", "backend", []string{"go"}, "ru"
	t19StudentWriteExclusive(t, ready, metadata)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("owned Student 20-minute deadline exceeded")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(stop); err == nil {
				value, err := state(ctx, owner)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal("owned final Student state unavailable")
				}
				existing, err := state(ctx, existingOwner)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal("owned final existing Student state unavailable")
				}
				value["url"], value["existing_student_id"], value["existing_student_state"] = server.URL, existingOwner, existing
				t19StudentWriteExclusive(t, result, value)
				return
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatal("owned Student stop read failed")
			}
		}
	}
}

func t19StudentWriteExclusive(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe Student metadata encoding failed")
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path+".tmp", os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive Student metadata creation failed")
	}
	_, writeErr := file.Write(append(raw, '\n'))
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil || os.Link(path+".tmp", path) != nil || os.Remove(path+".tmp") != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive atomic Student metadata publication failed")
	}
}

type t19StudentClock struct{}

func (t19StudentClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond) }

type t19StudentIDs struct{}

func (t19StudentIDs) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

func t19StudentUUID(value string) bool {
	_, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && value != uuid.Nil.String()
}
